summary: Closed Set 09 F34 for the DXVK one-click package path. Added a reusable package-integrity helper and behavior tests; dxvk-safe/dxvk preflight now requires SHA256SUMS.txt and verifies every listed package file before selector mutation. Unsafe manifest paths, malformed/self-referential/duplicate entries, missing files and hash mismatch fail closed. Preflight evidence records verified entry count and manifest SHA256.

review.architecture: The existing PC-fast build already generated SHA256SUMS.txt after all packaged runtime/support files were staged. The missing enforcement point was preflight before selector mutation.
review.lifetime_sync: No DirectGPU resource lifetime, generation, producer fence, consumer ACK or OpenXR ownership source changed.
review.stereo_correctness: No rendering, WVP, HUD/menu, SkyGlow or visual code changed.
review.performance: No game/host hot-path work changed. Hash verification occurs once during preflight.
review.adversarial: The behavior test explicitly rejects support-file tampering, missing listed files, '..' traversal entries and duplicate manifest paths; manifest self-reference/rooted paths are rejected by the helper.

behavior_verified: Valid two-file manifest verifies and returns Verified=true with exact entry count.
Tampered support file produces Package manifest hash mismatch.
Deleted listed file produces Package manifest file missing.
Path traversal entry '../...' is rejected as unsafe.
DXVK preflight requires SHA256SUMS.txt and runs Test-OutRunVRPackageIntegrity before game/backend payload mutation.
Preflight report records PackageIntegrity.Verified, EntryCount and ManifestSha256.
PC-fast package includes OutRunVR-PackageIntegrity.ps1 so runtime verification is available in the extracted test payload.
